rows: Identification is influential but not the whole geography/institutions debate.
Institutions are rules; organizations are players.
Community governance is not a universal anti-privatization rule.
Corruption's effect depends on state capacity and political settlement.
Institutional complementarities resist one-off transplant reforms.
Benefits are mixed where commons or displacement risks dominate.
Fukuyama: capacity, rule of law, accountability
These are distinct; strengthening one can weaken another.
